questions.feedback: Check the definition and explain it in your own words before retrying.

questions.prompt: Does missing resolution evidence necessarily imply no?
questions.answer: No; the predefined rule may require an ambiguous or void outcome.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Writes an independently resolvable question and tests boundary cases.
scoring.transfer: Write five low-stakes forecasting questions about fictional or publicly verifiable events. Include one numeric outcome, one binary event and one conditional question. Define resolution rules before assigning probabilities.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; quiz score alone is insufficient.
